Hexmap World Creator terrain palette. The note name is the palette name. Each table row is one terrain:
colors are any CSS color (in backticks, like `#3b82f6`, so they aren't read as tags), icons are file names from the icon picker, categories group
terrains in the picker, and the type says what a terrain is (water, forest, star…) for
generators and the hex table. Edit here, in the palette editor, or from the terrain tool on
the hex map. Copy this note into another vault's palettes folder to share it.

| Terrain | Color | Icon | Icon color | Category | Type | Impassable |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| ocean | `#14223d` |  |  |  | water | (yes) |
| forest | `#2d5a27` |  |  |  | forest | (no) |
| hills | `#8a7f5a` |  |  |  | hills | (no) |

## Path types

Paths maps on this palette can draw. Width is 1 (thin) to 10 (thick). Style is solid, dashed or dotted. Routing is how the line is drawn: through (a smooth curve through hex centres), meander (a smooth curve through the middles of the edges between hexes) or edge (straight along the hex borders). Avoid impassable is yes or no: whether auto-route goes around impassable terrain (no also lets generated submaps run it through water, like a river). Auto-route is direct (keeps to the straight line) or winding (wanders). Carves is what an overworld path of this type turns the hexes it crosses into when you confirm it into its regions: a terrain's name, a terrain type (water), or none. Carve width is 0 (the path's hexes) or 1 (and the hexes beside them). To have no path types, delete the rows but keep the header line.

| Path | Color | Width | Style | Routing | Avoid impassable | Auto-route | Carves | Carve width |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Road | `#a16207` | 4 | solid | through | yes | direct | none | 0 |
| River | `#3b82f6` | 3 | solid | meander | no | winding | water | 0 |
